features: UGREEN Bluetooth 5.4 Transmitter Receiver: Dual Connection,12H Long Playtime,2-in-1 Wireless Aux Bluetooth Adapter 3.5mm for TV, Home Stereo, Airplane, Gym, Speakers, Car and More (Note: incompatible with AirPods Pro 2/Airpods 4/Airpods 4 ANC2. )

2-in-1 Transmitter and Receiver: In TX mode, it's easy to convert a non-Bluetooth TV, PC, or gym/air flight equipment into a Bluetooth transmitter. In RX mode, it can stream music or phone calls to car/speakers/home stereo systems that don't have Bluetooth

Extended Playtime: Benefit from 12 hours of battery life in transmit mode, 11 hours in receive mode, and the USB-C charging port ensures ultra-quick and ultra-convenient charging. Spend less time concerned about battery life

Easy to Use: The Aux Bluetooth Adapter is easy to install and use. Please insert the Bluetooth 5.4 adapter into the AUX port after confirming to use TX or RX mode, press and hold the button for 3 seconds to power it on, it will automatically pair with your device

Wide Compatibility: The Bluetooth transmitter can connect to most devices with a 3.5mm AUX port, including car, TV, projectors, and more; enabling Bluetooth connection for a wireless audio experience. The aux wireless adapter is compatible with most mainstream Bluetooth devices, such as AirPods, BT headphones, etc. Whether upgrading a traditional wired speaker to Bluetooth or connecting the in-flight entertainment system to wireless headphones, this adaptor can easily achieve without complex setups

Note1: Compatible with AirPods / AirPods Pro. Not compatible with AirPods Pro 2, AirPods 3, AirPods 4 and AirPods 4 ANC. This adapter uses a 3.5mm AUX port, please verify your device interface before purchase

Note2:If you cannot connect, please note the following: 1Incorrectly entered pairing mode 2 Incorrect Bluetooth connection mode 3Interference from multiple device connections 4 It is recommended to keep the device within 10 meters free of obstacles

2-in-1 Bluetooth 5.4 Transmitter Receiver: This UGREEN 3.5mm wireless adapter supports TX and RX modes to meet all your wireless audio needs.TX: Plug into non-Bluetooth devices like TV or airplane jack to send audio to Bluetooth headphones/earbuds. RX: Plug into wired speakers or old car stereo to receive Bluetooth audio from phone/laptop and output sound. Ideal for home, car, and flights, it helps you ditch messy, tangled wires for convenient wireless audio
